response.sql: WITH order_exec_linked AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.ordertune, o.orderspivot FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault), order_counts_by_type AS (SELECT ordertune, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM order_exec_linked GROUP BY ordertune), total_count_cte AS (SELECT SUM(order_count) as total_count FROM order_counts_by_type), order_shares AS (SELECT ordertune, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / (SELECT total_count FROM total_count_cte) as share FROM order_counts_by_type), avg_share_cte AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM order_shares), above_average AS (SELECT ordertune, order_count, share, (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_cte) as overall_avg_share FROM order_shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_cte)) SELECT SUM(order_count) as sum_counts, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - overall_avg_share) as avg_excess FROM above_average
